visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black cap and brown collared shirt is standing outdoors against a gray corrugated metal wall, turning his head to look off-camera while his mouth moves as if speaking. The scene cuts to another man in a white hard hat, black vest, and safety harness standing near a weathered building with complex wiring. (2) The man in the cap looks upward with his mouth wide open while the man in the hard hat leans forward aggressively, holding a large power tool. (3) The man in the cap is now indoors in a studio setting with a black pegboard background displaying several brands of power tools like Metabo and Milwaukee. He stands in a medium shot, facing the camera and gesturing with his hands. (4) Extreme close-up of a human ear being examined by a hand, followed by a cut to a man in a white coat showing a device to a young child in a medical office setting. (5) The man in the brown shirt opens a thick white soundproof door and enters a specialized testing room. A woman in a white uniform uses an otoscope to look into his ear while he sits still. (6) The man sits at a desk with the female staff member, both looking at a white paper report with graphs. (7) Close-up shots of various hearing aid models in transparent display cases and custom earplugs being handled. (8) Detailed close-up of a pink fluid being injected into a man's ear using a syringe-like tool for molding. (9) Several finished earplugs of different colors (translucent, black) are shown resting on a table and in a black carrying case labeled Phonak. (10) The man in the cap holds a single small earplug between his fingers, bringing it very close to the camera lens while whispering.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video shifts between an outdoor urban construction site with blue fences and weathered walls, a studio with a black pegboard displaying tools, and a clean, brightly lit professional hearing clinic with white walls, examination equipment, and product display cases.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity industrial noise floor with the distinct percussive clatter of hammer drills and metallic impacts. Two male voices shout loudly over the noise; the first has a sharp, projected delivery, and the second responds with high-arousal aggression. (2) A synthesized high-frequency whoosh effect triggers a transition. The audio landscape shifts immediately to a clean studio environment with minimal floor noise. (3) A bright, upbeat BGM with acoustic guitar strumming and a light rhythmic beat starts. A male narrator begins speaking in a calm, authoritative yet friendly tone with clear articulation and balanced loudness. (4) Distinct mechanical click of a latch sounds as a door opens, followed by the narration continuing seamlessly. (5) Several high-pitched 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are inserted rhythmically alongside the narration. (6) A soft squelching liquid sound accompanies the injection of molding material. (7) The narrator ends the recording by dropping into a low-volume whisper with high breathiness and close proximity to the microphone, creating a dramatic acoustic contrast.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to raise awareness about the risks of hearing loss, particularly in high-noise environments, and promotes hearing health services and custom-fit hearing protection products. It uses an relatable opening scenario to hook the audience, followed by educational facts and a demonstration of professional testing and customized solutions at the Honyun hearing aid clinic.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly visits the clinic, undergoes tests, and showcases the products with clear brand visibility for 虹韻助聽器 and Phonak.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully balances a social media personality's energetic style with professional medical branding to make the topic of hearing loss engaging and actionable.
